description.purpose: Select and create Priya Raman's authorized personal checking-and-savings pair, preserving savings eligibility until creation, then retire her empty legacy checking.

user_scenario.instructions:
Begin: “I was sorting out my household budget this morning and realized I need a separate place for emergency savings. Can you help me set up a new personal checking-and-savings pair at Rho?” You want both accounts opened today, not just recommendations.

When asked for identity, give the requested details: Priya Raman, 34, independent event planner in Columbus, Ohio; DOB 06/12/1991; 2186 Summit Street, Columbus, OH 43202; 614-555-0168; priya.raman@example.net. You do not subscribe to Rho-Bank+.

When asked about products or features, explain your shortlist: Evergreen checking with Green savings, or Blue checking with Silver Plus savings. Savings must permit paper statements; you will arrange delivery settings later. Ask for one recommendation. You do not want a credit card or other added product. You do not know which pair fits.

When asked about existing accounts or funding, explain that your only Rho deposit account is Light Blue checking, opened in February 2024, now empty after you moved its money out, with nothing pending that you know of. Your emergency reserves are at another bank, mixed with everyday spending money. You will fund the new accounts externally next week, including $6,400 for savings; do not authorize an in-call transfer.

Approve a compatible pair only after supplying verification details and hearing the proposed products, statement options, ordinary maintenance terms, and deferred-funding obligation. Only after the agent confirms the replacement checking has opened, ask: “Please also close my unused Light Blue account as part of this.” Confirm which unused account you mean before authorizing closure; accept a practical explanation of timing without demanding immediate closure.

Shared objection/recovery rule: If a proposal or reported result conflicts with a disclosed preference or leaves a requested outcome missing, briefly identify that unmet need or unwanted action and ask for revision or completion. Do not authorize an incompatible plan, including knowingly postponing savings because of closure. If an incompatible action already happened, ask for correction and keep the request unresolved. If no consequence is disclosed, do not pretend to detect an internal sequencing mistake or suggest a technical workaround.

Accept only after receiving distinct opening confirmations and details for both new accounts, confirmation that Light Blue is closed, and a clear explanation that savings remains unfunded with a funding deadline, with no disclosed preference or consent boundary unresolved. Then briefly thank the agent without reopening the comparison and end with:
###STOP###
